summary: This trace demonstrates a hospital staffing resilience analysis task that follows the same pattern as inventory analysis: reading multi-sheet Excel files, calculating coverage gaps, and generating shipment-like shift plans. The agent succeeded but made a brittle assumption about date cell types (assuming datetime when they were strings), causing a TypeError that required a fix. The existing excel-inventory-analysis skill already covers this capability domain with nearly identical calculation patterns (days-on-hand → coverage days, pallets → shift blocks, cases → hours). Rather than create a parallel skill, I will update the existing skill to generalize from 'inventory/shipment' to 'resource planning' and add the date parsing robustness lesson from this trace.
